description: This file defines the EntityAccessControlHandlerInterface interface for Drupal's entity access control system, including method signatures for access checks, cache reset, and module handler setup.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access to an operation on a given entity or entity translation, returning a boolean or AccessResultInterface based on parameters.

methods.name: createAccess
methods.description: Checks access to create an entity, with optional bundle, account, and context parameters.

methods.name: setModuleHandler
methods.description: Sets the module handler for this access control handler.

methods.name: fieldAccess
methods.description: Checks access to an operation on a specific entity field, considering field definition and optional field items.
